parts.name: Root
parts.description: State container for the combobox. Owns open state, input value, selection logic, filtering, and keyboard interaction.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable ID used to generate internal ARIA IDs (recommended for SSR).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables all user interaction.

props.name: pending
props.description: Exposes busy async state via data-pending. Trigger and clear become non-interactive while pending.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the combobox interactive but prevents value changes.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value(s). Single value for single mode, array for multiple mode. Can be bound with bind:value

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled selection: the component stops writing back to `value`
and only reports through `onChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not
flowing the new value back down. Off by default, because `bind:value` — the
common case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Current input value. Can be bound with bind:inputValue

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: Initial input value for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: controlledInputValue
props.description: Opt into fully controlled input text. See `controlledValue`.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: How selecting an already selected option behaves: 'toggle' deselects it, 'replace' keeps it selected.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single-select or multi-select mode.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether to close popover after selection. Default: true for single, false for multiple

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popover is open. Can be bound with bind:open

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description: Opt into fully controlled open state. See `controlledValue`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the popover opens: 'focus' | 'input' | 'press'. Default: 'press'

props.name: filter
props.description: Function used to filter items locally. Set to null to disable local filtering.

props.name: filterActionItems
props.description: Whether items with onAction should participate in local filtering.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called when the input value changes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover open state changes.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: items
props.description: Optional: Array of items. Used internally to resolve selected labels before options mount.

props.name: children
props.description: Composed combobox parts.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the root group element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the combobox group

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels this combobox group

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the combobox.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the combobox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pending
dataAttributes.description: Present while the combobox is in a pending (busy) state.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is readonly.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Text input with role="combobox" that syncs the typed value, active descendant, and keyboard handling with the root.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the input

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels this input

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of element that describes this input (e.g., usage instructions)

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-form-type
dataAttributes.description: Tells password managers the field is not a credential, so they leave it alone.

dataAttributes.name: data-lpignore
dataAttributes.description: Asks LastPass not to attach its autofill overlay to the field, which would cover the listbox.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Optional button that toggles the popover without stealing focus from the input.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the trigger button.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom trigger content. If omitted, a chevron icon is rendered.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popover is open.

parts.name: Button
parts.description: Compatibility alias for ComboBox.Trigger. Prefer ComboBox.Trigger in new code.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom trigger content. If omitted, a chevron icon is rendered.

parts.name: Clear
parts.description: Optional button that resets the input value and clears the selection without stealing focus from the input. Disabled when there is nothing to clear.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the clear button.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom clear content. If omitted, an X icon is rendered.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: Floating container for the options, positioned relative to the combobox input group. Composes Popover.Root and Popover.Content in non-modal mode.

props.name: children
props.description: Popover content, typically ComboBox.List.

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset along the main axis from the anchor element.

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether to flip when there's insufficient space.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: Boundary element for positioning constraints.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description: Whether the popover is non-modal (allows outside interaction, no focus trap, no scroll lock).

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether clicking outside the popover should close it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape should close the popover.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Whether losing focus (blur) should close the popover. Defaults to true for non-modal popovers.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element or selector to focus first when modal trap activates.

parts.name: List
parts.description: Listbox bridge for the options. Delegates selection state and mode to ComboBox.Root and accepts additional ListBox.Root props such as class and emptyPlaceholder.

props.name: items
props.description: Optional items for dynamic rendering - overrides items from ComboBox context

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the listbox. Receives item in dynamic mode.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the options near the viewport. See `ListBox`'s own `virtualizer` for
the constraints (uniform row height, the list is the scroller).

With no `items` of its own it virtualizes the ComboBox's, already filtered: the
per-item filtering an unvirtualized list relies on cannot work when most items were
never rendered.

props.name: header
props.description: Rows rendered above the options, inside the listbox (e.g. a "Create …" action).

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: Content shown when the list is empty. Can be a string or a Snippet.

props.name: getItemKey
props.description:
Reads an item's key — the same value passed as `ListBox.Item`'s `id`.

Only needed together with `virtualizer`: a Shift range is otherwise measured over
the options in the DOM, which for a virtualized list is just the rendered window,
so the range stops wherever the user happened to have scrolled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of items that should be disabled and non-selectable.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `value` and
only reports through `onChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not flowing
the new selection back down. Off by default, because `bind:value` — the common
case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class to apply to the listbox container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the listbox. Announced by screen readers.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
Id of a visible element that labels the listbox. Use instead of `aria-label`
 when the list already has a heading on screen.

props.name: disableFocusHandling
props.description: Disable DOM focus handling on the root container for virtual-focus compositions.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the last item to the first (and back).

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether typing characters moves focus to the option whose text matches.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: A selectable option with combobox-specific filtering, virtual focus, and registration logic. Requires a unique id; use onAction for command-style items that run instead of selecting.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when this item is activated as an action instead of selected.

props.name: closeOnAction
props.description: Whether to close the popover after running onAction.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for this item. Used for selection tracking.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text value for typeahead search. If not provided, extracted from content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item is disabled and non-selectable.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class to apply to the item element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the item.

props.name: isFocusVisibleOverride
props.description: Override the focus-visible presentation state.

props.name: onItemHoverStart
props.description: Callback when pointer hover should move logical focus to this item.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Override the visual pressed state. When provided, this value is used instead of internal press tracking.

parts.name: ItemIndicator
parts.description: Visual selection indicator rendered inside ComboBox.Item. Defaults to a checkmark icon.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render when selected (defaults to checkmark icon)

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Force show the indicator regardless of selection state

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the indicator wrapper.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "checked" while the item is selected, "unchecked" otherwise.

props.name: formatMessage
props.description: Build the announced message from the visible item count.

parts.name: Tags
parts.description: Container that renders the selected values as tags in multiple mode. Supports an optional single-line overflow mode.

props.name: children
props.description: Snippet to render each tag. Receives { item: { value, label } }

props.name: overflow
props.description:
Optional overflow indicator. When provided, the tag row is constrained to
a single line: tags that don't fit are not rendered, and this snippet
renders at the end with how many are hidden (plus `visible`/`total`, so the
consumer can e.g. show a summary when nothing fits). Expected to render a
single element. Without `overflow`, every tag renders and wrapping is left
to the consumer's styles (the previous behaviour).

props.name: reserve
props.description:
Horizontal space (px) to keep free inside the parent for siblings such as
the search input, so the overflow calc doesn't claim the whole row. Only
used in overflow mode.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the tags container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the tag row. Defaults to `Selected values`.

parts.name: Tag
parts.description: Visual token representing one selected value in multiple selection mode.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the tag - use ComboBox.TagRemove for remove button

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tag is focused.

dataAttributes.name: data-tag-id
dataAttributes.description: The selected item id represented by the tag.

parts.name: TagRemove
parts.description: Button that removes its tag from the selection.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the button (defaults to X icon)

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the remove button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name of the button. Defaults to `Remove <tag label>`; override it to
translate the verb, or to name the tag by something other than its combobox
label (which falls back to the raw value when the selection was set
programmatically and the option never rendered).
